trace.question: What is the percentage of posts whose owners had a reputation of over 1000 in 2011?
trace.evidence: percentage = DIVIDE(COUNT(Id where YEAR(CreationDate) = 2011 and Reputation > 1000), COUNT(Id) ) * 100;

attempts.sql:
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', p.CreaionDate) = '2011' AND u.Reputation > 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(p.Id) AS percentage
FROM posts p
LEFT JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id

trace.final_sql:
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', p.CreaionDate) = '2011' AND u.Reputation > 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(p.Id) AS percentage
FROM posts p
LEFT JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
trace.answer: About 7.13% of posts had owners with a reputation over 1000 in 2011.
